summary: Usable right after pairing: a QR pairing on a host with a mounted --workspace grants Read/Control/Approval on that project in the same registry write (DeviceRegistry::verify_pair_and_grant); re-pair adds the mounted project (idempotent when unchanged) and never revives a revoked key. --list-devices/--revoke-device kept; the four --grant-device-* CLIs and --project are deleted (now unknown arguments). The six-digit safety code is removed end to end (Rust invite/issuer/wire Pair message, schema contract, fuzz corpora, Android invite/handshake/UI/codec). Pair and Authenticate responses report control_available truthfully (device holds Control on a project this host mounted); Android accepts true and propagates it.

notes: Desktop confirmation design: the QR is shown only on the owner's screen, is one-use and expires in <=300 s; scanning it is the physical-presence proof and therefore the desktop confirmation (blueprint section 3: the QR is the control plane). Uniform for interactive `host pair`, `--plain`, `--desktop` and the non-interactive resident `host serve` (no extra y/n prompt, no blocking listener thread). A stolen QR is detectable: the owner's own scan fails as already used and the Accepted counter rises; --list-devices/--revoke-device then remove the device. The user guide documents this.

Mounted project = directory_id of the canonicalized --workspace (via ProjectWorkspace::with_directory, same as --list-projects). Without --workspace nothing is granted and control_available stays false.

Re-pair semantics changed from 'never expands' to 'adds the currently mounted project' (a fresh QR scan is the same consent); unchanged grants are byte-identical no-ops; revision bumps fence older handles.

Kept DeviceRegistry::verify_pair_and_register (no grant) and set_permissions as library APIs used by many existing tests and by unit tests in src/remote/{command,worker_admission,worktree_host}.rs and src/tui.rs, to avoid touching files ZE-510/511 are moving.
Wire schema change: the Pair payload no longer has safety_code (schema-contract.json, generated RemoteSchema.kt and fuzz corpora updated). No released client exists.
The requested `cargo test ... --test remote_host_e2e -- --ignored --include-ignored` is rejected by libtest (mutually exclusive flags); ran `-- --include-ignored`.

Host-driven instrumentation tests (HostPairingTest, HeadlessHostTest, EmulatorQrHostTest, PhysicalQrHostTest, SessionHostTest, LanSocketRoutingTest, PairingScreenTest, ScannerResultTest) were updated to the new API and semantics and compile, but were not executed (they need an emulator plus the host harness); phase 'ungranted_projection_verified' is renamed 'paired_projection_verified'.
